role: independent opportunity challenge before flagship selection
scope: Read-only primary-source research; no customer demand validated; all scale arithmetic is conditional scenario math, not market evidence.
decision_principle: Prefer a small independently useful instrument that permits a previously blocked activity. Do not equate AI coding speed, synthetic success, or a large social need with a saleable differentiated product.

shortlist.name: Private Evidence Commons
shortlist.before: Several owners have insufficient local sample sizes but cannot transfer row-level research data.
shortlist.first_offering: A contracted, reproducible pooled statistical result from a small consortium, with machine-checkable query scope, explicit disclosure budget, local execution and independent verification.
shortlist.beneficiary: Existing multicenter research network or industry consortium with already-authorized data access; avoid claiming access to unaffiliated patients.
shortlist.paying_reason: Reduce custom analyst/integration work and provide an accountable delivered analysis. Payment cannot be justified by new cryptography; mature free alternatives already exist.
shortlist.construction_possible_today: Executable federated sufficient-statistics computation, secure-aggregation demonstration, exact pooled-versus-central equivalence checks, fault/dropout rejection, reproducible manifests. Production privacy requires separate audited security infrastructure and governance.
shortlist.acceptance: Agreed estimand and denominators reproduced within declared tolerance on fresh datasets; every site's allowed query manifest matches; prohibited small-cell or repeated differencing releases rejected; no assertion of clinical validity.
strongest_alternatives: SecretFlow or Flower secure aggregation plus ordinary Python
Trusted research environment with authorized centralized analysis
shortlist.recent_change_needed: Current frontier agent operation might lower bespoke schema/analysis construction costs. This must be measured; federated statistics have existed for years and are not newly invented.
shortlist.commercial_challenge: Governance, data harmonization and trust may dominate coding cost. Small cohorts create output-disclosure problems even when individual updates are encrypted. Supplier/data-owner participation must have separate utility.
shortlist.successor: Validated schema mappings, query contracts and numerical tests permit a second independently useful class of estimand or cross-owner experiment. Ordinary artifact reuse baseline may tie agent successor.
shortlist.billion_scale_condition: For example, 100000 accepted cross-owner analyses/year at an evidenced USD10000 net productive benefit would reach USD1bn annual value created; neither reachable count nor benefit has been established. Do not present as TAM.
shortlist.recommendation: Potentially constructible; commercial expansion unearned until evidence of paid demand and net savings against mature free stack.

shortlist.name: Rare-cohort study assembly
shortlist.before: A sponsor cannot establish sufficiently reliable multicenter eligibility counts from one site.
shortlist.first_offering: Executable cohort-feasibility contract and site contribution report over authorized data.
shortlist.beneficiary: Trial sponsor, CRO or research network.
shortlist.acceptance: Exact eligibility semantics, independently adjudicated samples, reproducible counts and uncertainty from unsupported criteria; no claim that counts equal enrollments.
shortlist.commercial_challenge: ATLAS already defines cohorts and generates runnable study code; ENACT already supports federated feasibility across over 50 CTSA hubs. NIH funded an AI-driven federated clinical/genomic matching project beginning July 2026. Naive claim of an overlooked untouched market is false.
shortlist.recommendation: Reject as flagship unless a specific unsupported criterion or participation arrangement is shown to change an actual decision.

shortlist.name: Cross-laboratory control-sharing instrument
shortlist.before: Laboratories cannot compare results because controls, protocols or measurement scales differ.
shortlist.first_offering: A jointly funded cross-laboratory reference/control plan and executable comparability evidence for a narrowly specified assay.
shortlist.beneficiary: Small assay developers, research consortia or analytical-service laboratories.
shortlist.construction_possible_today: Can perform computational harmonization on existing public data; cannot deliver a new certified reference material or prove physical measurement validity without actual samples and experiments.
strongest_alternatives: JUMP Cell Painting protocols and public resource
shortlist.commercial_challenge: JUMP already coordinated 12 centers and shared an extensive public resource. Statistical normalization alone cannot establish scientific interchangeability. Physical validation and metrological traceability dominate.
shortlist.recommendation: High consequence but reject as a complete local commercial seed if physical validation is hidden inside the simulator.

shortlist.name: Executable accessible scientific figures
shortlist.before: A reader using assistive technology cannot inspect the structure and quantities of a complex technical figure.
shortlist.first_offering: A publisher receives a keyboard-navigable semantic figure with source values, MathML, long description and exact-data checks.
shortlist.beneficiary: Technical publishers, university accessibility teams and STEM course authors.
shortlist.acceptance: All semantic quantities reproduce the source; keyboard operation works; real assistive-technology user verifies task completion. Automated conformance alone is insufficient.
strongest_alternatives: Desmos audio trace and tactile export
skilled accessible-authoring team using current AI
shortlist.commercial_challenge: Useful and locally constructible, but strong free alternatives exist. General figure transcription could be ordinary remediation, which the mandate excludes as an unrelated easy fixture. Need genuinely more expressive research instrument.
shortlist.recommendation: Reserve candidate; expansion requires paid publisher demand and user validation beyond this session.

shortlist.name: Executable laboratory protocol foundry
shortlist.before: A small laboratory has a scientific intent but no valid automation script.
shortlist.first_offering: A reviewed, simulated protocol and acceptance pack for a specific robot.
shortlist.commercial_challenge: Opentrons already offers protocol generation, modification and simulation. Software simulation cannot verify chemical yield, pipetting accuracy or biological reproducibility.
shortlist.recommendation: Reject generic generation; require a new physically validated experimental capability before treating it as flagship.

shortlist.name: Shared grid-access capacity arrangement
shortlist.before: Individually unattractive generation/storage/load projects cannot obtain economical grid access.
shortlist.first_offering: A joint, contingent commercial design for shared capacity with explicit curtailment and failure obligations.
shortlist.beneficiary: Developers and industrial loads in an identified constrained area.
shortlist.construction_possible_today: Can execute dispatch and incentive models on public inputs. Cannot deliver utility approval, firm capacity or engineering certification locally.
shortlist.commercial_challenge: May degrade into a conventional optimization fixture. DOE roadmap already recommends hosting-capacity work; site-specific grid models and utility agreements are missing.
shortlist.recommendation: Do not select for current campaign without a narrow independently acceptable delivered instrument and actual grid data.
